title: TikTok One
content_data:
[TikTok One](https://ads.tiktok.com/creative) is an all-in-one TikTok creative platform where you can access millions of creators, connect with production partners, and uncover creative insights — all in one place. To learn more about the TikTok One platform, see [About TikTok One for advertisers](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/about-tiktok-one). 

This group consists of the following endpoints:

## Authentication
* [Get, renew or revoke a Creator access token](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-renew-or-revoke-a-creator-access-token/v1.3)
* [Obtain the authorized Creator permissions](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-the-authorized-creator-permissions/v1.3)
* [Get authorized TTO Creator Marketplace accounts](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-authorized-tto-creator-marketplace-accounts/v1.3)
* [Check TTO Creator status](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/check-tto-creator-status/v1.3)
* [Get the details of a TTO Creator Marketplace account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-details-of-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3)

## Creator insights and discovery
* [Get TTO Public Account Insights](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-tto-public-account-insights/v1.3)
* [Get TTO Public Media Insights](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-tto-public-media-insights/v1.3)
* [Get Authorized TTO Creator Insights](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-authorized-tto-creator-insights/v1.3)
* [Get Authorized TTO Media Insights](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-authorized-tto-media-insights/v1.3)
* [Get TTO creator ranking or search labels](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-tto-creator-ranking-or-search-labels/v1.3)
* [Get top TTO creator rankings](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-top-tto-creator-rankings/v1.3)
* [Discover TTO creators](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/discover-tto-creators/v1.3) 

## TTO campaign management
* [Create a Brand Profile for your TTO account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-brand-profile-for-your-tto-account/v1.3)
* [Get the Brand Profiles for your TTO account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-brand-profiles-for-your-tto-account/v1.3)
* [Create or update a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-or-update-a-tto-creator-marketplace-campaign/v1.3)
* [Update a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/update-a-tto-creator-marketplace-campaign/v1.3)
* [Get TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-tto-creator-marketplace-campaigns/v1.3)
* [Send or revoke a TTO video linking request](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/send-or-revoke-a-tto-video-linking-request/v1.3)
* [Get TTO video linking requests as a brand](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-tto-video-linking-requests-as-a-brand/v1.3)
* [Report on TTO Creator Marketplace videos](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/report-on-tto-creator-marketplace-videos/v1.3)
* [Subscribe to the linking of a TikTok video to a TTO campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810521739537409#item-link-Subscribe%20to%20the%20linking%20of%20a%20TikTok%20video%20to%20a%20TTO%20campaign)

##  Spark Ads Authorization
* [Apply for Spark Ads authorization](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/apply-for-spark-ads-authorization/v1.3)
* [Get the authorization status](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-authorization-status/v1.3)

## TTO anchor management
* [Create a webpage anchor](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-webpage-anchor/v1.3)
* [Get webpage anchors](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-webpage-anchors/v1.3)
* [Delete a draft anchor](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/delete-a-draft-anchor/v1.3)

## TTO creator management
* [Join a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign as a creator](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/join-a-tto-creator-marketplace-campaign-as-a-creator/v1.3)
* [Link a video to a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign as a creator](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/link-a-video-to-a-tto-creator-marketplace-campaign-as-a-creator/v1.3)
* [Get TTO video linking requests as a creator](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-tto-video-linking-requests-as-a-creator/v1.3)
* [Approve or reject a TTO video linking request as a creator](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/approve-or-reject-a-tto-video-linking-request-as-a-creator/v1.3)
